name: fly
description: Deploys the host's server to fly.io: one machine only for volume-backed state, secrets never in fly.toml, deploying ships code, not content. Contributes Fly operations, server config generation and the FlyV1 credential scheme.
author: Tovu

jini.summary: Puts the application server itself online on Fly.io.
jini.deploymentAdvice: Use the production runtime settings supplied by the deployment target.

credentialCards.title: Connect Fly.io
credentialCards.label: fly.io
credentialCards.intro: Connect Fly.io to inspect and deploy the application server and manage its Machines.
usedFor: Deploys your application server and checks its status and logs
Creates and manages apps when you grant access to the organization
credentialCards.keyHint: Use a deploy token scoped to this app. Use an org-scoped token only when creating or managing apps across that organization. In the Fly dashboard, select the app or organization, then Tokens. Avoid the short-lived login auth token.
